scope: Proposition 3.1 of the manuscript “A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-the-nearby-Lagrangian-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 340 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7a208ddd7ef666), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B = S9 and let p ≥ 20. Suppose that fb : R2p → R, b ∈ B, is a smooth family satisfying the following conditions: 1. it is homogeneous at infinity, with smooth homogeneous data in Tp,p; 2. each fb has exactly one critical point, which is nondegenerate and varies smoothly with b; 3. the stable spherical class of the family at infinity is zero in [B, BG]. Then its stable tube class is zero in [B, T].
